newsitem.title: USA: Bombay Co says Thompson named president.
newsitem.headline: Bombay Co says Thompson named president.

text.p: Bombay Co Inc said on Thursday that Carson Thompson has replaced Robert Nourse as president and chief executive officer of the company.
Thompson, who has been chairman of the board since 1982, also served as chief executive officer of the company from 1982 until his retirement from that position in 1991.
Bombay said that Clayton Niles, a director of the company since 1982, has been elected to the position of chairman of the board.
The company also said that Aagje Nourse, executive vice president of merchandising and marketing, has left the company.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to give further details.
